subject: Kelp tank presentation
body: The school tour reaches the kelp tank at 11. Please keep the feeding demonstration to five minutes so the group can make the touch pool session on time.

subject: Glasshouse plant labels
body: The new labels are printed and sorted by bed number. The fern house opens at 10 on Sunday, and the west path is closed while the paving dries.

subject: Release site transport
body: The two rescued possums are ready to return to the reserve. We can collect them at 7 a.m. on Friday, when the road is quiet and the weather is expected to be mild.

subject: Hive inspection workshop
body: Our instructor has space for 14 participants on the 22nd. Bring a veil and gloves if you have them; we will provide the smokers and spare suits.

subject: Harvest lunch booking
body: I have reserved the long table for 16 people at noon. The kitchen can prepare a vegetarian option if we send the final number by Thursday.

subject: Mould wash schedule
body: The small vat is due for its weekly clean on Monday. I will bring the new brushes from the supply room, and we can start after the morning batch is pressed.

subject: Ice order for market day
body: We need six bags of flake ice delivered before 5 on Friday. The loading door will be staffed from 4.30, so the driver can come straight to the cold room.

subject: Sunday detour notice
body: The number 8 bus will use Mill Lane while the bridge is closed. The temporary stop is beside the post office, and normal service resumes after 6 p.m.

subject: Airport queue allocation
body: The early flight bank is busier than usual tomorrow. We have assigned two extra cars to the rank between 5 and 7, and the dispatcher has the updated roster.

subject: Route map revision
body: The Oak Run stop moves to the south side of the road next week. Please distribute the revised map to drivers before their Monday morning run.

subject: Hull sanding progress
body: The first coat is dry and ready for a light sanding. We can turn the hull tomorrow afternoon if the workshop crew is free to help lift it.

subject: Fabric sample return
body: The striped sample is the best match for the lounge chairs. Could you send back the other swatches with the courier so I can put the board away?

subject: Mantel clock service
body: The movement is running smoothly after cleaning. It will need another day in the workshop before I can confirm the timekeeping and arrange pickup.

subject: Cello bridge fitting
body: The bridge is cut and fitted to the instrument. We can tune it together when you come by Friday afternoon, then leave it to settle overnight.

subject: Boot sole replacement
body: The new soles are stitched and the heels have been trimmed level. Your boots will be ready to collect after 3 tomorrow.

subject: Sofa cleaning appointment
body: We can come on Friday between 10 and noon. Please vacuum the cushions beforehand and leave the sofa empty so the team can begin as soon as they arrive.

subject: Specimen packaging update
body: The new foam inserts fit the small tubes more securely. We tested the box on the usual route, and all samples arrived upright and cool.

subject: Crown shade confirmation
body: The ceramic crown is ready for the final check. The shade is A2 as requested, and the bite surface follows the updated impression.

subject: Battery collection
body: The replacement batteries are at reception for you to pick up. We have also printed the care leaflet in a larger type size.

subject: Lens coating sample
body: The anti-glare coating looks even under both lamps. I have included a clear sample for comparison and can arrange another finish if the customer prefers it.

subject: Extractor hood commissioning
body: The airflow test is complete and the reading is within the design range. I will send the service sheet once the electrician adds the final sign-off.

subject: Passenger lift visit
body: We have scheduled the annual service for 24 September. The engineer will need access to the plant room and about two hours without the lift in use.

subject: Car park line painting
body: The crew can paint the north lot on Sunday morning. The surface should be dry by noon, and the cones can come down after the supervisor checks the lines.

subject: Tower collection
body: The mobile tower is ready to collect from the west yard. Please bring the hire docket so the store team can match the pieces before loading.

subject: Laser level availability
body: The laser level is available from Monday through Wednesday. It comes with a tripod and receiver, and we will check the calibration before you take it.

subject: Culvert clearing visit
body: We plan to clear the culvert on Thursday morning. The road crew will place signs at both ends, and access should reopen before the school bus arrives.

subject: Meter replacement notice
body: The meter replacement on Fern Street is booked for 11 October. Water may be off for about 30 minutes, and the crew will knock before starting work.

subject: Sapling order for spring
body: We have reserved 40 river birches and 25 dogwoods for the school project. They can be picked up the week of March 18, once the ground is workable.

subject: Autumn aeration
body: We will aerate the front lawn in the first week of October. If the soil is very dry that day, we will move the visit to the following week.

subject: Drip line fittings
body: The 16 millimetre elbows are back in stock. I can send the box with your regular order, or you may collect it from our yard this afternoon.

subject: Herb bench replenishment
body: The thyme and oregano arrived in good condition. We placed the trays on the sunny bench near the entrance and labelled the new varieties.

subject: Friday rose shipment
body: The pale peach roses are on the early truck. We have set aside three bunches for your shop and will add the greenery when it comes in.

subject: Public skate session
body: The Saturday public session runs from 1 to 3. Skate hire is available at the desk, and beginners can use the marked practice area beside the boards.

subject: Route setting closure
body: We are resetting the orange wall Tuesday night, so that section will be closed Wednesday morning. The blue and green routes stay open as usual.

subject: Saturday class cover
body: I can teach the 9 a.m. class this weekend. Please leave the key mat by the front desk and let the regular group know the room has changed to Studio B.

subject: River launch conditions
body: The river is running gently this week, and the launch is clear. We have single kayaks and two tandem boats available for Saturday's booking.

subject: Coach for the science museum
body: The driver will meet your group outside the main hall at 8.15. There is space beneath the coach for backpacks and lunch coolers.

subject: Early pickup confirmation
body: Your pickup is set for 4.40 on Wednesday morning. The driver will wait by the blue sign at the south entrance and can take two suitcases per passenger.

subject: Sheet delivery change
body: Our route has shifted by one day this week. Clean sheets will arrive Thursday morning rather than Wednesday, and the towel collection stays on Friday.

subject: Portable oven reservation
body: The portable oven is reserved for your festival weekend. We will deliver it with the two racks and the outdoor-rated extension lead on Friday.
